me.title: Build something. Leave it better.
me.body: I'm Reza. Most of my free time goes to learning about computers, usually something I can use in the next thing I build. I want that curiosity to turn into work that helps someone.

sections.label: who I am
sections.text: I don't split life into work and everything else. For me, living means building and growing, so the line between the two is thin.

sections.label: what matters
sections.text: Creating value: something that works, helps someone, and wasn't there before.

sections.label: time off
sections.text: Honestly, most of my free time goes to learning. My curiosity is mostly about computers, so when I'm not working I'm usually picking up something I can use in the next thing I build.

sections.label: what I'm after
sections.text: Becoming a better person, and finding ways to help the people and the community around me.

sections.label: why SYSP0
sections.text: In networking, I started with how machines talk. Python taught me to hand repetitive work over to code. Now that I'm working with AI, there's more to learn from the ground up. P0 is my name for that starting point.
